aiExplanation.summary: This file activates CZaza and assembles its shared services, Providers, commands, and event workflows.
aiExplanation.detail:
- activate: Creates shared Notes infrastructure, injects the validated AI response language into PersonalNoteScopeService, and registers UI and source-change workflows.
- scopeNotes: Binds one workflow to the selected Team or Personal Note Store, with Team fallback at compatibility boundaries.
